shortDescription: Simultala Awasiya Vidyalaya SAV Jamui Class VI Admission 2027. Applications are open from 03 August 2026 to 28 August 2026, with dummy admit card available for the entrance process.
content:
Simultala Awasiya Vidyalaya (SAV), Jamui Bihar has released the online registration for Class VI Admissions 2027. The application window is open from 03 August 2026 to 28 August 2026.

Both boys and girls are eligible for the admission process, subject to the academic and age conditions specified in the official brochure. Candidates are advised to read the complete notification before submitting the form.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 03/08/2026
  • Last Date for Apply: 28/08/2026
  • Complete Form Last Date: 28/08/2026
  • Class 6 Pre Exam Date: October 2026
  • Class 6 Mains Exam Date: December 2026

Application Fee

  • General / BC / EBC / EWS: ₹200
  • SC / ST: ₹50

Application fee payment is accepted through debit card, credit card, net banking and UPI.

Age Limit

Minimum age: 10 years; maximum age: 12 years as on 01/04/2027.

Eligibility

  • Passed Class 5th examination
  • Spent or studied full academic session in Classes III, IV and V
  • Must satisfy the conditions mentioned in the official admission notice

Vacancy / Seats

60 seats each for boys and girls under SAV Class VI admission.

Documents Required

  • Aadhaar / Apaar ID
  • Passport-size photo with light / light green background
  • Residence certificate
  • Category / caste / EWS / PH certificate wherever required
  • Academic and other supporting documents for admission

How to Apply

  1. Visit the official SAV portal.
  2. Complete the registration and login process.
  3. Fill the Class VI admission application form.
  4. Upload the required documents.
  5. Pay the fee if applicable.
  6. Review and submit the form.
  7. Download the confirmation and keep a printout.

Read the full notification and the official document list before submission. Visit the SAV official website for the latest updates.
